description: Find all gaps (empty spaces) on the timeline between clips. Useful for identifying where content is missing or where clips can be tightened.

min_gap_seconds.description: Minimum gap duration in seconds to report (default: 0.04 = ~1 frame at 24fps)

sequence_id.description: Sequence name or ID. Uses active sequence if omitted.

track_type.description: Which track type to analyze (default: both)

name: get_timeline_gaps

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Get Timeline Gaps
